hold_text: Held for the manager's merge, not self-landed: pr-landing-guard R5 refuses to self-land any edit to a research/queue unit other than its last_dispatched_at stamp (a pre-registered unit may not be changed on a self-land path), and this PR changes run.timeout_minutes on 8 units. The change is mechanical and does not touch any question, command, harness, metric or decision rule: eight kaggle_cpu units (RQ-20261101-78fc-44..50, -53) declared timeout_minutes 360 while script_run.plan refuses anything over 330 (MAX_TIMEOUT_MIN), so the dispatcher logged dispatch_failed for them every cycle and they could never run. Lowered to 330 (the job ceiling is 360). Evidence: dispatcher run 41958393971 logs, and script_run.plan on each unit returns the error before and none after. Adds tests/test_research_queue_timeouts_in_preflight_range.py (1,472 units with a timeout, 0 out of range; fails with the 8 reverted). The cause predates #23021. Merging it restores the idle kaggle_cpu backend; no gate, order path or config changes.
